cells.gaps: Sources disagree on when the National Digital Accessibility Policy took effect: a December 2024 issue described as mandatory (LBY-004), or adoption in April 2025 with mandatory compliance still to come in January 2026 (LBY-002). No delivery of accessible services by a government body is found.
cells.note: A paper of September 2026 reports observing more than 20 government and private platforms and finding most fail the national policy's standards. A later yes answers the earlier ones, so 5.
